purpose: Implement an exact temporal-energy description in seconds, separate from recording-relative occupancy, without promoting either to a sparse trait or perceived-duration label.

primary_context.use: Distinguish temporal extent, representation and descriptor concept. The paper's envelope-threshold effective duration and spectral flatness are not adopted as validated LossyTrace cutoffs; this new raw-energy quantile measure is not a Timbre Toolbox implementation.
Distinguish temporal and spectral descriptors and their summaries; no MPEG-7 conformance claim or classifier is adopted.

definition.input: Finite signed-24-bit integer samples and a positive integer sample rate. A run (length, amplitude) is an exact lossless representation of constant consecutive samples; a sample-sequence adapter must agree with runs.
definition.density: On sample cell [n/fs,(n+1)/fs), define w(t)=x[n]^2. Its integral is sum(x[n]^2)/fs, in integer-amplitude-squared seconds, not joules, calibrated pressure, loudness or perceived duration. Include DC, all frequencies and background; do not filter, denoise, estimate an envelope or subtract a noise floor.
definition.quantile: For positive total mass, t(q)=inf{t: integral(0..t) w / integral(all) w >= q}. Interpolate exactly within each constant-density sample cell using rational arithmetic. At a flat CDF plateau, use its earliest boundary, not its midpoint or the next active sample.
definition.centroid: integral(t*w(t))/integral(w(t)), computed at exact sample-cell midpoints. This uses raw squared samples, not the smoothed envelope of the cited paper.
definition.context: Report recording duration, first nonzero cell start, last nonzero cell end, exact total nonzero-cell duration, and central-90 span divided by recording duration. Nonzero support is literal digital support, not salient activity. The ratio is intentionally context-relative; the span in seconds is not.
definition.zero_mass: Return unsupported with null quantiles, spans, centroid, support endpoints and context ratio. Preserve the observed recording duration and zero exposure. Do not emit zero duration as a silent sparse label.
definition.scope: This is a selected continuous development measurement, not a selected source-trait classifier or perceptual metric. The 5/25/50/75/95 percent positions specify descriptive summaries, not pass/fail margins. No source sparse cutoff is introduced.

experiment.base_profiles: All four combinations of duration 15 or 30 seconds and event onset 5.950 or 6.000 seconds, with one 1.600-second constant interval and zeros elsewhere. These are consumed synthetic context witnesses reused to compare measurement meanings, not fresh natural evidence.
experiment.separated_profile: Duration 30 seconds, zero background, equal-amplitude intervals [6.000,6.800) and [18.000,18.800). Total nonzero duration equals the one-interval base, but temporal energy spread need not.
experiment.background_profiles: All four combinations of duration 15 or 30 seconds and constant background amplitude 10 or 100, replacing that background with amplitude 1000 on [6.000,7.600). These are declared level constructions, not clean captures or perceptual noise levels. Do not remove positive background to obtain invariance.
experiment.inventory: Nine physical profiles, two sample rates and two signed gains: 36 summaries. Retain both native-rate base summaries and exact gain-invariance/exposure-scaling checks for every profile. All shared physical profiles are exact cell-density refinements at doubled rate, not a claim about media resamplers or real analog captures.
experiment.comparisons: Separately check a 50-ms translation, adding 15 seconds of exact zeros, separating equal-energy events, and appending positive background. Preserve any changed energy quantiles under positive background. Compare old base occupancy values through the predecessor's bound exact overlap calculation; do not relabel consumed sources or claim another actual descriptor/audio run.
experiment.independent_check: At 20 and 40 samples per second, independently expand every profile and signed gain into sample cells, enumerate squared weights and exact cumulative masses, and compute quantiles/centroid directly. Compare all summary fields against the run-integrated implementation, then compare physical-time/exposure fields with 48000/96000 refinements. These low-rate checks are numerical density analogs, not acoustic or perceptual stimuli.

execution.media: Synthetic integer runs and small numerical cell arrays in memory only; no audio file is read, generated, saved or played.
execution.output: Exact rational strings and finite synthetic aggregate measurements. No private source identity, path or PCM hash. CLI accepts only the frozen synthetic mode.

next_requirement: Use physical temporal spread and recording context as distinct fields in a future source-structure definition. Background, carrier dependence and spectral time-locality still require scope decisions and fresh validation before source assignment. Do not promote this technical measure to perceived duration, event detection, a clean-source label or a replacement frozen capture rule.
